integrity: The general theorem has an analytic proof, supported by exact rational finite diagnostics. The stated originality assessment is provisional pending independent expert review.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gini stability is established for a star with equal leaf observation masses, a positive hub mass, and any independently strictly positive fusion-edge penalties. Arbitrary leaf masses, non-star trees, other seminorms and nonquadratic fidelities are not treated. Historical-priority comparisons are qualified; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp Gini stability and reciprocal mass thresholds for star-graph fusion denoising
